title: Luscious Savory Middle Eastern Labneh Bowl
description: A savory and cozy Middle Eastern dish featuring labneh, gochujang, and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a snack or light meal. This halal-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Start by mixing the labneh, gochujang, and kombu-cold-extract in a bowl until well combined.
Add the sumac to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Toast the pita bread slices until crispy and cut into triangles.
Assemble the labneh bowl by spreading the labneh mixture on the bottom, followed by a layer of cucumber slices, tomato dice, and a sprinkle of parsley.
Serve the labneh bowl with toasted pita bread triangles on the side.
Garnish with additional parsley and sumac if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
